column1: # Construction family challenge set — depth programme follow-on (Part C.1 family accounting).
# Purpose: stage 5's family accounting found the construction family at 50.0% on 2 atoms in the
# frozen holdout — under-tested, neither pass nor fail. This set feeds the family a real sample.
# A construction atom (features.ts) is emitted per predicate whose record carries
# states.construction. The parser sets that state in exactly eight branches:
#   en: imperative, existential, weather — zh: ba, bei, correlative, a-not-a, serial.
# Copular questions, contractions, fragments and the rest of the stage-3 territory earn no
# construction atoms; they are scored by scripts/construction-challenge.tsv and not re-tested here.
# Columns (tab-separated): lang <TAB> class <TAB> sentence <TAB> expected construction value in G0 <TAB> note
# Classes: core = scored (built to the branch signatures in parse.ts, vocabulary attested in the
# lexicons); probe = adjacent territory the branch prose suggests but the coded signature may not
# cover — reported descriptively, never in the family score.
# Authored by Kavi, 2026-11-18; frozen once written — sha256 recorded in docs/ansci/construction-family-challenge.md.
